responsibility: This scheduling description models UltraSPARC I and II for the SPARC DFA scheduler. It captures their quad-issue slotting rules, asymmetric integer units, load writeback delays, branch and store bypass behavior, floating-point single/double pipelines and divider usage, and VIS scheduling, providing a detailed early-UltraSPARC pipeline model distinct from the simpler UltraSPARC-III and Niagara-family descriptions.
